selection_rule: One sample per dataset, chosen from the input image and the ground-truth mask before any prediction was inspected. The four together cover five conditions: alligator cracking, concrete pavement, asphalt pavement, a thin linear crack, and a low-contrast crack; asphalt is carried by both the alligator and the thin-linear rows.

selection_criteria.thin_linear: Mean crack width = foreground area / skeleton length, computed over every test image of the dataset. CrackMap GOPR0318_(1) is the narrowest of the 24, at 4.0 px (0th percentile).
selection_criteria.low_contrast: Absolute difference between the mean grey level inside the mask and in a 15-pixel dilated ring around it, divided by 255. DeepCrack IMG24-1 is the lowest of the 230 usable test images, at 0.057 (0th percentile). The ring rather than the whole frame is used so that distant pavement texture does not dilute the measurement.
selection_criteria.concrete_pavement: Surface type is read from the image; CamCrack789 image-128 is a single thin crack on smooth concrete and was already the concrete sample of the previous selection.

alligator_note: The alligator sample was NOT chosen by an automatic descriptor, because the two obvious candidates both fail. Skeleton branch density ranks the chosen image 4th rather than 1st, since it normalises by skeleton length and a large mesh grows numerator and denominator together. Enclosed-cell count (components minus Euler number) ranks it 597th of 633, because the annotation leaves sub-pixel gaps where cracks meet, so almost no cell closes; the images it ranks first are single wide cracks whose "cells" are annotation specks inside the crack body. The sample was confirmed by inspecting the candidates at full size. This is recorded so that a later refresh does not "correct" the choice to a descriptor ranking.

checkpoint_rule: Use the prespecified final epoch of the fixed budget on every dataset, matching the reported public-dataset matrix. The budget is 50 epochs since 2026-09-09 (epoch_50.pth); it was 5 before that. An earlier rule (final on DeepCrack, best_fgIoU elsewhere) was abandoned when the best_fgIoU criterion was found to be constant across epochs for some model-dataset pairs at the short budget.
